mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which erodes consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a CPI index above 230 signals persistent inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 900 thousand units signals strong residential construction, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 3-month moving averages signals broad-based economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and INDPRO are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (PAYEMS * INDPRO) over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, high retail sales (RSAFS) above $420 billion signals strong consumer spending, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS exceeds $420 billion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an ultra-accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
